title: Blue Ocean Journey - Coral Reef Cleanup at Nha Trang Bay
location: Along Tran Phu Beach & Hon Tre Island, Nha Trang
description: A diving campaign to collect ocean-floor debris and clean tourist beaches, protecting the marine ecosystem of Nha Trang Bay.
meetingPoint: April 2 Square, Tran Phu Street, Loc Tho, Nha Trang

schedule.activity: Gather at April 2 Square, check-in and safety briefing
Depart to Nha Trang Bay by boat
Underwater and coastal cleanup, coral reef monitoring
Return to shore, waste sorting, and group debrief
